messages:
Sam: FYI Acme Corp says they were charged VAT on invoice INV-2024-089 even though they provided an EU VAT ID. Can we confirm next steps?
Lina: can you paste the VAT ID and attach the invoice PDF/screenshot? I'll run a VIES check.
Sam: VAT ID: GB123456789. Attached screenshot of the invoice showing VAT line (EUR 2,100). Customer also mentioned a resale certificate.
BillingBot: Invoice INV-2024-089 created 2024-05-20 14:12 UTC. Tax applied: EUR 2,100. Billing profile: Acme Corp (acct_9842).
Lina: quick VIES check in browser...
Lina: VIES result: VALID (checked 2024-05-20). That suggests they should be eligible for reverse charge, assuming B2B. Looks like our billing profile didn't have reverse-charge enabled for that account.
Marta: If VIES is valid we can issue a credit note for the VAT portion and reissue a new invoice without VAT (reverse-charge). Finance needs: VAT ID, company registration or resale certificate, billing address, original invoice number, and written confirmation they're B2B.
Sam: Customer rep says they're a B2B client and will forward a signed exemption form. What exact format do you need for the resale cert?
Marta: PDF of resale certificate OR company registration extract that matches VAT ID. Signed exemption form is fine — must include company name, VAT ID, billing address, and a signature or official stamp. Also note: we need to confirm place of supply is outside our country to apply reverse charge.
Lina: I'll prepare a draft credit note. Marta — please confirm we can mark the original invoice as reversed and reissue once docs received. +@Marta
Marta: Confirmed. Finance will: (1) validate docs, (2) issue credit for VAT amount, (3) reissue invoice net of VAT and annotate "reverse charge applied". ETA 48-72h after docs are received. I'll tag it FIN-2024-742.
Sam: Suggested reply to customer (short):
```
Hi Ana — thanks for the VAT ID. To apply reverse charge and remove VAT from INV-2024-089 we need:
- Your EU VAT ID (we validated it on VIES)
- A copy of your company registration or resale certificate (PDF)
- Confirmation that this is a B2B supply (billing contact name/email)
Once we have those we'll issue a credit and reissue a VAT-exempt invoice. Expect 48–72 hours after submission.
Thanks,
Sam (Redwood Support)
```
Sam: attaching sample signed exemption form template to speed this up.
Lina: VIES link for reference: https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/ — paste the VAT ID there to confirm.
Marta: Also note internal steps: add tag "vat-exempt-pending" to acct_9842, create finance ticket, and block automated self-billing until resolved to prevent auto-charges.
Josh: heads-up for account management — might impact renewal conversation. @Josh please follow up after resolution.
Sam: I'll follow up with the customer to collect the docs and will ping here when received. :thumbsup:
Lina: once we reissue, update the Stripe/Billing system to store the VAT exemption flag on the customer's billing profile so future invoices skip VAT. I'll handle the update.
Marta: logging FIN ticket: FIN-2024-742, notes attached.
Sam: customer says they'll send docs by EOD. Will update.
